description: Generic map tiles needed by the starter mission map (assets/pack/data/starter/) and the title-screen demo map (assets/pack/data/map10/). Both .bd1 files reference the same 5 texture names (wall.bmp, floor.bmp, crate.bmp, roof.bmp, ground.bmp) per docs/MAPGEN.md's 10-slot texture table, but D3DGraphics::LoadMapdata(&BlockData, directory) (src/d3dgraphics-directx.cpp:1384, src/d3dgraphics-opengl.cpp:2041, called with "data\\starter\\" / "data\\map10\\" at src/gamemain.cpp:238,284 for map10) resolves texture files relative to the map's own directory, so each directory needs its own copy of every file it uses -- not generated yet, no images produced by this task.

a flat corrugated grey-brown sheet-metal roof panel seen from above, regular shallow ribbing running one direction, light surface rust spots
packed brown earth courtyard ground seen from directly above, small pebbles and fine soil grain, faint dry cracks spread evenly
